# D3DDD - Dubai 3D Design & Draft

> Marble and stone shop drawings, AutoCAD drafting, fit-out drawings, 3D rendering and contractor websites for Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the rest of the UAE. Founded by Shoaib Hussan. English and Arabic.

D3DDD prepares fabrication and installation drawings that contractors, fabricators and consultants can review. Drawing sets are issued as AutoCAD DWG and PDF. Shop-drawing fees are quoted per project. Published website prices are the Starter (AED 1,200), Business (AED 2,000) and Premium (AED 3,500+) packages, with the 5-page contractor website at AED 2,000 and a 50% deposit. There is no street address and no phone number. The studio is in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

## Services

- [Marble and stone shop drawings](https://d3ddd.com/marble.html): Fabrication drawings, cutting lists, slab layouts and BOQ for stone.
- [Architectural drafting](https://d3ddd.com/services/architectural-drafting/): Shop drawings, CAD detailing, as-built, joinery and fit-out sets.
- [Architectural designing](https://d3ddd.com/services/architectural-designing/): Concept layouts, space planning, elevations and design development.
- [Architectural estimation](https://d3ddd.com/services/architectural-estimation/): BOQ, quantity take-offs, material schedules and tender packages.
- [3D rendering and visualization](https://d3ddd.com/services/3d-rendering-modeling-visualization/): Still renders, modeling and walkthroughs.
- [Website development](https://d3ddd.com/services/website-development-designing/): Business sites and landing pages for contractors.
- [All services](https://d3ddd.com/services/): The five service lines, in English.
- [الخدمات](https://d3ddd.com/ar/services/): The same services in Arabic.

## Projects

- [Villa Entrance Lobby Waterjet Marble Medallion & Flooring Layout – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/entrance-lobby-waterjet-marble-medallion-flooring/): A waterjet marble rosette with brass inlay, set inside a numbered ground-floor slab layout.
- [Luxury Villa Ground Floor Marble & Stone Flooring Layout – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/villa-ground-floor-marble-flooring-layout/): A colour-zoned ground floor plan with a radial marble hall, herringbone majlis and full slab set-out.
- [Villa Swimming Pool & Outdoor Seating Tiling Details – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/villa-swimming-pool-and-outdoor-majlis-tiling-details/): Set-out plans, long sections and step, coping and fireplace details for a villa pool, deck and outdoor seating.
- [Luxury Bathroom Marble Wall & Floor Cladding Shop Drawings – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/luxury-bathroom-marble-cladding-shop-drawings/): Wall and floor cladding for two villa bathrooms, with mitred corners, LED grooves and fluted feature panels.
- [Venatino Marble Freestanding Bath Vanity Shop Drawing – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/venatino-marble-bath-vanity-shop-drawing/): A 2200 mm freestanding Venatino vanity: elevations, section, edge details and a slab-mapped cutting plan.
- [Paonazzetto Marble Vanity Tops Shop Drawings – Residential Villa, Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/paonazzetto-marble-vanity-tops-shop-drawings/): Seven undermount Paonazzetto vanity tops with sink sections, edge profiles and true-scale slab previews.
- [Marble Slab Cutting Layout & Bathroom Cladding Drawings – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/marble-slab-cutting-layout-bathroom-cladding/): Numbered Venatino bathroom panels nested on real slab photos for low-waste, vein-matched cutting.
- [Fusion Blue Marble Door Frames & Skirting Slab Layout – Dubai](https://d3ddd.com/projects/fusion-blue-marble-door-frame-and-skirting-slab-layout/): Fusion Blue door frames, lintels and skirting nested slab by slab so every piece follows the vein.

## Founder

Shoaib Hussan, founder of D3DDD – Dubai 3D Design & Draft. Draftsman working with contractors, fabricators and consultants in the UAE.

## Areas served

Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah, across the United Arab Emirates. Work is delivered digitally. No street address is published.
